title: CapMap-MS-TTA: 3rd Place Solution for the MUMU Track of the 8th LSVOS Challenge at ECCV 2026
abstract: arXiv:2609.18206v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The MUMU track of the 8th Large-scale Video Object Segmentation (LSVOS) Challenge requires a single unified multimodal model to jointly solve image tagging (Task A), open-vocabulary object detection (Task B), and English captioning (Task C) under strict resource constraints (<=0.5B parameters and <=8 GB peak GPU memory). We present CapMap-MS-TTA, a training-free submission built on Microsoft Florence-2-base (~231M parameters), combining caption keyword mapping with multi-scale flip test-time augmentation. Task C uses the native  pathway with length/token sanitization. Task A maps the same detailed caption into the official quality/scene/event vocabularies via an expanded keyword lexicon with whole-word matching and a lightweight expand-hints stage. translated_title: CapMap-MS-TTA：ECCV 2026 第八届LSVOS挑战赛MUMU赛道季军方案
translated_abstract: 第八届大规模视频目标分割（LSVOS）挑战赛的MUMU赛道要求单一统一的多模态模型在严格的资源约束下（参数量不超过0.5B，GPU峰值显存不超过8GB）联合解决图像标注（任务A）、开放词汇目标检测（任务B）和英文图像描述生成（任务C）三项任务。我们提出CapMap-MS-TTA，这是一个基于微软Florence-2-base（约2.31亿参数）构建的无需训练的参赛方案，将描述关键词映射与多尺度翻转测试时增强相结合。任务C使用原生通路并进行长度/词元清理。任务A通过扩展的关键词词典（采用全词匹配）以及轻量级的提示扩展阶段，将同一详细描述映射到官方的质量/场景/事件词汇表中。任务B运行Florence-2开放检测，并配合多尺度和水平翻转测试时增强（TTA），随后进行标签感知的非极大值抑制（NMS）。在无需微调的情况下，该系统（原文在此处截断）...
tldr: 该方案基于微软Florence-2-base模型，通过免训练的描述关键词映射与多尺度翻转测试时增强策略，在严格资源约束下用单一模型联合完成图像标注、开放词汇目标检测和英文图像描述三项任务，获得第八届LSVOS挑战赛MUMU赛道季军。
en_tdlr: A training-free solution built on Microsoft Florence-2-base that combines caption keyword mapping with multi-scale flip test-time augmentation, enabling a single unified model to jointly solve image tagging, open-vocabulary detection, and English captioning under strict resource constraints, winning 3rd place in the MUMU track of the 8th LSVOS Challenge.
